fact: Namibia's two responsible ministries signed an agreement integrating the National Population Registration System with the social protection system to verify existence and live status of persons, and the Covid-19 Emergency Income Grant applicants were all verified against the NPRS.
The Office of the Prime Minister says electronic identity verification of social grant beneficiaries already prevents payments to deceased beneficiaries.
The Office of the Prime Minister says government has saved approximately N$16 million on social grants through improved identity verification.
